entities.summary: Tenshin Nasukawa (b. 1998-08-18, Chiba Prefecture) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Chiba Prefecture and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, architects & designers, asia.
